g.text: well, i guess first, do u know what a piano is? maybe?
so there's sort of this song here that anyone who has been around a piano knows, called 'Soul & Heart'
Yeah, an instrument like my Shawzin.
it's a two person song though, just a few notes <RETRO_EMOJI_GIVELOVE>
oh oh OH! the Shawzin, my ears yearn! won't you play for me one day?
Are you offering to be my teacher, Ms. Aoi?
You don't seem like you'd be a good teacher.
I can't - I never really learned.
i was thinking it could be fun - find a piano in some abandoned store, if it has metal i can move it carefully..
maybe i can teach you not to be so rude. forget it - your loss.
oh that's ok that's okay, anyway - piano
Ms. Aoi reporting for duty. First lesson: piano lesson!
me too, the guys would freak!
first up: there's lots of keys. 88 last i counted. each one makes a noise. doh rei mi fa...
in any case - partner. for one song. could be fun right?
Doh Rei Mi Fa? This is sounding like Void Tongue...
Please don't put this on the test, Ms. Aoi!
i read in an On-lyne interview once that music can be like, therapy. maybe it's something we can both enjoy?
oh jeeze, music should not make you think of such things. no fear. only Soul & Heart.
I don't think I'm ready for this, but don't stop on my account.
I'd really love that. I know music can let people feel.
Not sure I'll feel much but I'm happy to help you, Aoi.
tell ya what, i'll work on this lesson plan for ya!
my star student, Ms. Aoi expects the best! Now repeat after me: Doh Rei Mi Fa
oh, i see. i know, i do. ok. no sweat, never a prob, let's just listen to a song or two later?
yesss! music is the soundtrack to our lives.
okie then, we'll do our best, right? when i feel up for it i'll msg u!
and i'll find away to do it that doesn't make you remember anything scary.
ok, holdin u to it. in meantime, remember: 88 keys on a piano, they make different sounds!
oh - shoot. gotta run, we'll pick up the lesson another time!
hahaha oml i should never be a teacher. but lets talk about piano again some day, ok?
